title: OAC v0.1 Status list (JWS payload, typ oac-status+jws)
description: Which Mandates a signer revoked. encoded_list = 'u' + base64url (no padding) of the GZIP-compressed bitstring, as in the W3C Bitstring Status List Recommendation (15 May 2025): index 0 is the left-most bit, at least 16 KB uncompressed. Rules beyond the schema: exactly one gzip member and nothing after it; at most 2 MB uncompressed; iat < exp <= iat + 7 days; signed by the Mandate's own signer (same iss).
